verified: Control Center displays the configured primary provider/model/version/ref, repository allowlist and data classifications, and requires an explicit confirmation that excludes machine secrets, App keys, installation tokens and Git credentials before submitting the enable command.

Gateway v2 strictly parses github.monitor.set_state enable/pause/revoke payloads, requires disclosure for enable, requires an explicit retain/delete history policy for revoke, rejects disclosure on non-enable actions and never carries raw GitHub secrets.

The server-side monitor lifecycle handler validates authenticated Owner/Agent scope, active installation, configured model/repository/classification disclosure and monitor CAS revision; it synchronizes the repository scheduler job and returns a stable revision result reference.

Revocation persists the monitor as revoked before cancelling its scheduler job and removing the bounded mirror, then invokes the Owner-selected history policy port; a revoked installation can persist a non-active monitor stop state in SQLite.
Read-only capability exposes bounded repository read operations and explicitly denies push, comment, merge, workflow dispatch, deployment creation and Git credential access.
Mirror storage is bounded, content-addressed, owner-only and symlink-safe; repository revocation removes the monitor cache.
Every admitted event is passed to model relevance and the shared Attention decision; no deterministic semantic pre-filter bypasses model judgment.
Offline mode records an open/closed coverage gap and has no polling, reconciliation or history scan path.
Budget exhaustion records BUDGET_BLOCKED; normal non-silent decisions persist a Web inbox delivery with event/run/result references.
